---
title: "TAOOH — primary preparation"
subtitle: "Validated five-state weekly history with first- and second-order lags"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The weekly ordinal outcome is coded 1 = alive/out of hospital, 2 = planned
admission, 3 = ER, 4 = unplanned admission, and 5 = dead. State 5 is checked
as absorbing before incomplete weekly grids are handed to MICE.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
cohort_path <- project_path("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
taooh_path <- project_path("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-taooh.parquet")
cohort_schema_path <- project_path("data", "schema", "cohort_follow_up.yml")
taooh_schema_path <- project_path("data", "schema", "taooh.yml")
output_path <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "prepared.parquet")
stage_id <- "primary-taooh-preparation"
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "data-validation.R"),
  here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"), here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"),
  here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"), knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-taooh-data
#| include: false
module_branch(
  runtime = runtime,
  stage_id = stage_id,
  input_paths = c(cohort_path, taooh_path, cohort_schema_path, taooh_schema_path),
  output_paths = output_path,
  code_paths = code_paths,
  metadata = list(endpoint = "taooh", horizon_weeks = 26L, states = 1:5,
                 death_absorbing = TRUE),
  worker = function() {
    cohort <- module_input(cohort_path, cohort_schema_path)
    taooh <- module_input(taooh_path, taooh_schema_path)
    module_require_columns(cohort, c("id", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "albumin", "c_reactive_protein"), "cohort_follow_up")
    module_require_columns(taooh, c("id", "week", "y_taooh"), "taooh")
    if (any(!taooh$y_taooh %in% 1:5)) stop("TAOOH states must be exactly 1 = home, 2 = planned, 3 = ER, 4 = unplanned, 5 = dead.")
    taooh <- taooh[order(taooh$id, taooh$week), , drop = FALSE]
    bad_absorbing <- any(unlist(tapply(taooh$y_taooh, taooh$id, function(value) {
      death <- which(value == 5L)
      length(death) > 0L && any(value[seq.int(death[1L], length(value))] != 5L)
    })))
    if (bad_absorbing) stop("TAOOH death state 5 must be absorbing within every patient.")
    cohort$diagnosis <- as.integer(factor(cohort$diagnosis, levels = sort(unique(cohort$diagnosis))))
    base <- cohort[, c("id", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "albumin", "c_reactive_protein"), drop = FALSE]
    grid <- merge(base, data.frame(week = 1:26), by = NULL)
    observed <- taooh[, c("id", "week", "y_taooh"), drop = FALSE]
    observed <- observed[observed$week >= 1 & observed$week <= 26, , drop = FALSE]
    observed <- observed[!duplicated(observed[c("id", "week")], fromLast = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    grid <- merge(grid, observed, by = c("id", "week"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
    grid <- grid[order(grid$id, grid$week), , drop = FALSE]
    grid$y <- grid$y_taooh
    grid$tx <- as.integer(grid$tx)
    grid <- grid |>
      dplyr::group_by(id) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        yprev = dplyr::lag(y, 1L, default = dplyr::first(y)),
        ypprev = dplyr::lag(y, 2L, default = dplyr::first(y))
      ) |>
      dplyr::ungroup()
    grid$yprev <- as.integer(grid$yprev)
    grid$ypprev <- as.integer(grid$ypprev)
    module_save_parquet(grid, output_path)
  }
)
```
